I’m standing with parents and advocates to push for the Kids Online Safety Act to hold platforms accountable, strengthen parental tools, and bring transparency to the algorithms shaping what our kids see.

Video

Trump really just said “I don't think about Americans’ financial situation.”

That’s what he should be doing every day.


Acyn (@Acyn)

Trump on Iran War:

Reporter: What extent are Americans’ financial situation motivating you to make a deal?

Trump: Not even a little bit. I don't think about Americans’ financial situation

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Acyn/status/2054262313788768765#m

It was an honor meeting with the Artemis II crew today.

Their courage and dedication represent the very best of America.
Great to be with some energized DFLers from across Lyon, Yellow Medicine, and Redwood counties last week. Minnesotans are ready to come together, get to work, and move our state forward.

Right now, I'm heading to our Senate Agriculture Committee hearing on fertilizer supply & affordability.

Farmers in Minnesota & nationwide are being squeezed by rising input costs — like higher fuel costs — driven by the Administration’s tariffs & the ongoing conflict in Iran.

Video

This weekend I was honored to join hundreds of MN National Guard families whose loved ones are stationed overseas at a very special lunch sponsored by Serving Our Troops. Good to also see Rep. McCollum and Mayor Her. Thanks to Mancini’s and volunteers for serving steaks to our troops overseas as well.

Trump’s ballroom is another example of this administration’s misplaced priorities. Americans see that — and they don’t support it.

Video

The Minnesota Legislature voted to establish an independent Office of the Inspector General to investigate fraud - the bill passed with strong bipartisan support in both the House and Senate.

This is an important step in rooting out fraud and holding government accountable.

The Fargo-Moorhead diversion project is critical to protecting homes and businesses from flooding. It was great to zoom in to join leaders to celebrate this step forward — I worked across the aisle with Sen. Hoeven to secure this funding and keep this effort moving.

inforum.com/news/moorhead/f-…

Minnesota cannot afford to have a rubber stamp for the President in the governor's office. From the tariffs to health care cuts, I have taken on the White House and gotten things done for our state.

Video

On this day in 1858, Minnesota became the 32nd state to join the Union. Our state has an incredible history and a bright future ahead.

Happy Statehood Day, Minnesota!

One thing about my mom, she loved fishing. Some of my best memories growing up are from fishing trips with her. This fishing opener weekend, I'm thinking about my mom — and hoping everyone out there makes a few memories of their own. Happy Mother's Day!

Video

Happy Mother’s Day everyone! Here’s to moms getting some love 💕 today.

Miss my mom but here she is (aka grandma Rose) with Abigail, me and a butterfly 🦋 which was happy to leave the photo for a tree soon after it was taken!

Great to join an incredible group of women leaders including two former Latina leg leaders @MelisaFranzen and @TorresRayMN. And Minnesota’s strong & proud Latino community was all out last weekend at St. Paul’s Cinco de Mayo parade!

John and I stopped by Hmong Village in Saint Paul with Mayor Her and members of Minnesota’s Hmong community. This vibrant, economically thriving hub is home to so many small businesses that power our state.

It was an incredible morning in Eagan for the Susan G. Komen Race for the Cure. John and I joined breast cancer survivors, families, and advocates who were there walking and racing to raise money for a cure. 🏃🏻‍♀️ ❤️
Beautiful evening to kick off the Fishing Opener in Stillwater!

Happy fishing opener, Minnesota! Truly one of our state’s great traditions — bringing families together and supporting local businesses across our state. Good luck to all those heading out on the water this weekend! 🎣

In Marshall, I met with local leaders, small business owners, and providers about the child care shortage. When parents can’t find care, businesses can’t find workers. We must be committed to expanding access and increasing affordability.
